name: "$(Date:yyyyMMdd)$(Rev:.r)"

# Use the Azure DevOps pipeline templates
resources:
  repositories:
    - repository: "pipelines"
      type: "git"
      name: "Azure/template-pipelines"

trigger:
  batch: true
  branches:
    include:
      - develop
      - master
      - main

extends:
  template: "jobs/megalinter.yml@pipelines"
  parameters:
    megalinter_image_name: oxsecurity/megalinter-formatters
    megalinter_configuration:
      - name: DISABLE
        value: SPELL
    publish_to_sonarqube: true

parameters:
- name: azureSubscription
  displayName: Target Environment Subscription
  default: 'spn-dev-inf-mes'
  values:
  - 'spn-dev-inf-mes'
  - 'spn-ppr-inf-mes'
  - 'spn-pro-inf-mes'
- name: jobName
  displayName: Job Name
  type: string
- name: chunkSize
  displayName: Processing Chunk Size
  type: string
  default: '1000'
- name: fieldToBeChecked
  displayName: Field To Be Checked
  type: string
  default: ' '
- name: mode
  displayName: Materialized View Update Mode
  type: string
  default: FULL
  values:
  - FULL
  - INCREMENT
- name: plant
  displayName: Plants to Process (comma separated, leave blank to process all plants)
  type: string
  default: ' '
- name: processDateTimeFrom
  displayName: Processing Date Time From
  type: string
  default: ' '
- name: processDateTimeTo
  displayName: Processing Date Time To
  type: string
  default: ' '
- name: processingPeriod
  displayName: Processing Date Time Period
  type: string
  default: ' '
- name: failOnStandardError
  default: true

trigger: none

pool: ubuntu-2204-vmss-mesx

steps:
- task: AzureCLI@2
  displayName: Configure az cli error output
  inputs:
    azureSubscription: ${{ parameters.azureSubscription}}
    scriptType: 'bash'
    scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
    inlineScript: |
      az config set core.only_show_errors=yes
    failOnStandardError: false

- task: AzureCLI@2
  displayName: Run Materialized View Update Job 
  inputs:
    azureSubscription: ${{ parameters.azureSubscription}}
    scriptType: 'pscore'
    scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
    inlineScript: |
      function Get-ResourceGroupName {
        param (
          [string]$jobName
        )
        $environment = $jobName.split('-')[3]
        
        $resourceGroupName = "rg-gptmpxn01-dev-eun-mes-01"
        
        if ($environment -eq "pro") {
          $resourceGroupName = "rg-gptmpxp01-pro-euw-mes-01"
        } elseif ($environment -eq "ppr") {
          $resourceGroupName = "rg-gptmpxp01-ppr-eun-mes-01"
        }

        return $resourceGroupName
      }
      
      function Set-EnvironmentVariableValue {
        param (
          [Array] $envs,
          [string]$name,
          [string]$newValue
        )
        Write-Output "- Setting environment variable '$name' to '$newValue'"
        $kv = $envs `
          | Where-Object { $_.name -eq $name } `
          | Select-Object -First 1
        
        $kv.value = $newValue -eq ' ' ? '' : $newValue
      }

      $jobName = "${{ parameters.jobName }}"
      
      $resourceGroupName = Get-ResourceGroupName $jobName
      
      Write-Host "Using azureSubscription '${{ parameters.azureSubscription}}'"

      try {
        Write-Output " - Reading job '$jobName' from resource group '$resourceGroupName'..."
        $caj = az containerapp job show --name $jobName `
          --resource-group $resourceGroupName `
          --query "properties.template" --output json `
          | ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 10

        Write-Output "Setting environment variables..."
        Set-EnvironmentVariableValue `
          -envs $caj.containers[0].env `
          -name "CHUNK" `
          -newValue "${{ parameters.chunkSize }}"
        
        Set-EnvironmentVariableValue `
          -envs $caj.containers[0].env `
          -name "FIELD_TO_BE_CHECKED" `
          -newValue "${{ parameters.fieldToBeChecked }}"

        Set-EnvironmentVariableValue `
          -envs $caj.containers[0].env `
          -name "MODE" `
          -newValue "${{ parameters.mode }}"

        Set-EnvironmentVariableValue `
          -envs $caj.containers[0].env `
          -name "PLANT" `
          -newValue "${{ parameters.plant }}"

        Set-EnvironmentVariableValue `
          -envs $caj.containers[0].env `
          -name "PROCESS_DATETIME_FROM" `
          -newValue "${{ parameters.processDateTimeFrom }}"

        Set-EnvironmentVariableValue `
          -envs $caj.containers[0].env `
          -name "PROCESS_DATETIME_TO" `
          -newValue "${{ parameters.processDateTimeTo }}"

        Set-EnvironmentVariableValue `
          -envs $caj.containers[0].env `
          -name "PROCESSING_PERIOD" `
          -newValue "${{ parameters.processingPeriod }}"

        $caj `
          | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 `
          | Out-File -FilePath ./spec.json -Encoding utf8

        Write-Output "Triggering job '$jobName'..."
        
        az containerapp job start `
          --name $jobName `
          --no-wait `
          --resource-group $resourceGroupName `
          --yaml ./spec.json

        Write-Output "Job triggered successfully"
      }
      finally {
        if (Test-Path ./spec.json) {
          Remove-Item -Path ./spec.json -Verbose -Force
        }
      }
      
    failOnStandardError: ${{ parameters.failOnStandardError }}
